description: Use when the traveler wants to book flights they have chosen: the sellers offering that exact itinerary (airline direct and agencies), each with its price and a link that opens its checkout on the seller's site. An airline lists each of its fares by name (Basic Economy, Main Cabin and so on) with what that fare includes: seat choice, changes, refunds, carry-on and checked bags. So it also answers what a fare includes or what the fare without the basic restrictions costs. Takes a complete itinerary_id: one-way from search_flights, round trip from search_return_flights. Not for an outbound alone (choose a return first) and not a price watch (track_flight).

currency.description: The currency the traveler wants prices in: USD, CAD, EUR, GBP or ILS. Send it when the traveler names a currency or says where they live (euros for someone in Spain). Empty answers in US dollars, or in the currency the traveler picked on SlickTrip. Amounts you send in (max_price_usd, target_price_usd, a price per night) stay US dollars.
